steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen with the default Auction stage.
Provide the required project title for the create flow.
Open the Add Stages menu before adding the Technical Stage.
Verify that Technical Stage is available while RFQ is blocked by the existing Auction stage.
Confirm the project now has Technical Stage and Auction tabs.
Open the Auction stage overflow menu to remove Auction.
Delete the Auction stage so RFQ can be added.
Confirm deletion of the Auction stage.
Confirm only Technical Stage remains after deleting Auction.
Reopen Add Stages to add RFQ now that Auction is gone.
Verify RFQ is now offered and Auction is not.
Confirm the project contains Technical Stage and RFQ.
Open the Technical Stage overflow menu to remove it.
Delete the Technical Stage, leaving RFQ as the final stage.
Confirm deletion of the Technical Stage.
Assert the final project has exactly one stage tab: RFQ.
